Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 24-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Computer Vision [ECE_4410]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                With a neat schematic, explain the image formation process in human eye?                               (5)  
  
  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Demonstrate the process of sampling and quantization with respect to acquisition of digital images? (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Demonstrate the concept of order statistics filters used in digital image processing. Explain the      (5)  
  computational steps used in median filtering.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Explain the sharpening filter used in processing digital images with an example. State any one         (5)  
  application problems where sharpening filters can be used.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3)                Illustrate the edge detection problem in digital images. Why derivative filters are used in edge       (5)  
  detection.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Using basic principles, derive the mask coefficients of a Prewitt edge detector.                       (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Deduce the steps involved in forward selection method used in feature selection using fundamental (5)  
  principles?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Demonstrate the Bayes classifier used for pattern classification with the necessary computational      (5)  
  steps, assuming binary pattern classification problem.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                Differentiate between multilayer perceptron and support vector machine used in classification?         (5)  
  
  
  Page #1

A)                                                                Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Explain the interpretation of using kernel functions in learning SVM classifier. Illustrate with one    (5)  
  example kernel function, with its mathematical formulation?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  -----End-----
